market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI trading near $104-106 on May 5, 2026 with Strait of Hormuz closure and Iran-UAE tensions. EIA forecasts peak ~$115 in Q2. Need ~4-6% intraday spike to hit $110 over remaining 25 days. May 1 already saw spike to $106. Geopolitical risk premium could easily push to $110 on any escalation. Moderate-high probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether Hormuz tensions escalate further or de-escalate via Iran peace proposal.
